name: EV6 fixes
summary: eth0 guard, Android Auto recovery and a Status app
description: Three small services for the 2023 EV6 head unit. eth0-guard: with the stock ADB over TCP switch on, eth0 gets 192.168.0.123/24, which overlaps the projection hotspot and breaks wireless Android Auto; it narrows that to /32. aa-recover: after the car's own Wi-Fi hotspot has been used, the stock Android Auto receiver can get stuck; it restarts it. status: writes a status snapshot every 3 s for the Status app, which shows Android Auto, Wi-Fi, ADB, Leafia and recent fixes (in All Menus when the kia-menu launcher hook is installed).
author: hazptr
